Below are the decklists for the first three weeks of Vintage Super League's fifth season. Watch the excitement unfold Tuesday nights at 6:00 p.m. Pacific on [twitch.tv/magic](http://www.twitch.tv/magic)!

Follow the links below to take you to each player's current decklist.
